projects.title: AI Futures Project at MATS
projects.summary: Scenario writing, economic modelling and policy research on possible AI futures.

projects.title: Metaculus at MATS
projects.summary: Applied forecasting and research on AI diffusion, coordination and gradual disempowerment.

projects.title: Human Autonomy in the Age of Machines
projects.summary: Research on policies that protect human thought, learning and decision-making as AI use expands.

projects.title: Loss of Human Agency: An Agent-Based Model
projects.summary: A proposed model of how AI reliance and social influence could reinforce a loss of agency.

projects.title: Economic Impacts of Frontier AI
projects.summary: Research connecting AI adoption and technical benchmarks to changes in work and economic activity.

projects.title: From AI Exposure to Economic Shock
projects.summary: Early-warning indicators and policy responses for AI-driven labour disruption in Southeast Asia.

grants.title: AI for Science & Safety Nodes
grants.summary: Includes human empowerment and accountability. In-person participation at the San Francisco or Berlin hubs is strongly preferred.

grants.title: Essay contest: AI for human judgment
grants.summary: Up to GBP 20,000 in total prizes for essays of up to 1,000 words on AI, organisational design and human judgement. The top prize is GBP 10,000.
grants.deadlineLabel: End of day; timezone not specified

grants.title: GTR AI Safety Fund
grants.summary: Supports individuals and early-stage organisations, including work on AI's gradual effects on human development and social behaviour.

grants.title: Transformative AI Fund
grants.summary: Early-stage support for individuals and new projects addressing transformative AI. Typical grants are $10,000-$150,000.

grants.title: Capacity-building funding
grants.summary: Supports research communities, training and public resources about advanced AI risks. Direct research is usually a better fit for other programmes.
